question: HA#531 hanten C1 (Chrollo, BC-11): the new marker reader scripts/surface_marker.sh is a shell predicate, which BC-11 gives to TypeScript; HR-384 exempted only the bell scripts, on the same 'hook host has only nen, git, gh' grounds. How should this reader stand?

options.label: Exemption ⭐ (Recommended)
options.consequence: The reader stays shell as a recorded BC-11 exemption beside HR-384: it runs inside the session-start hook where node is not guaranteed. A new HR row names it and its header cites the row.

options.label: Own it to nen, freeze
options.consequence: File a nen verb that reads one file's generated marker; the shell reader is frozen to fixes only until nen ships it and Hatsu repins (the HR-171 pattern). The PR ships with the freeze recorded.
